limitations: PCB_PrimitivePad.getAll and PCB_PrimitiveComponent.getAllPinsByPrimitiveId are beta APIs explicitly not recommended for production in EasyEDA documentation. This read-only experiment does not enable a production tool.
Native pad layer code 12 occurs for the connector, but its physical meaning is not independently validated; never label it twelfth copper layer or back side.
Native coordinates are finite but units/transformations were not independently calibrated; do not compute physical mm loop length or pad-to-copper return-path adequacy from this observation.
Observed pad net metadata and schematic correspondence do not establish physical copper connectivity, EMC/ESD robustness, electrical reliability or manufacturing acceptance.
Only one EasyEDA Pro Web 3.2.209 disposable PCB was read; other runtimes and designs remain unvalidated. No native DRC/ERC, design writes, saves, exports, purchases or signoff.
